title: Parks
description: Parks in Sandy City, Utah. 41 multipolygon features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

links.title: Sandy City, Utah — Municipal Open Data
Sandy City GIS, the publisher of this layer
Licence status: Sandy City states no licence

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: NAME
table:columns.description: Name of the feature. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 41 rows, 41 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Address
table:columns.description: Street address of the feature. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 41 rows, 41 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Municipality
table:columns.description: Municipality the feature falls in. Several Sandy layers extend into neighbouring cities, so this is how to select Sandy's own. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 41 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Phone
table:columns.description: Public contact telephone number for the facility, not for an individual. Measured in the published file: Populated on 98% of 41 rows, 4 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Type
table:columns.description: Type of feature. See the measured values below, because the source layer declares no code list for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 41 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Acres
table:columns.description: Area in acres. Measured in the published file: Populated on 98% of 41 rows, 40 distinct values, ranging 0.0875616 to 175.631.

table:columns.name: Reservable
table:columns.description: Whether the park or its facilities can be reserved.

table:columns.name: Indoor_Pavilion
table:columns.description: Whether the park has an indoor pavilion.

table:columns.name: Outdoor_Pavilion
table:columns.description: Whether the park has an outdoor pavilion.

table:columns.name: Restrooms
table:columns.description: Whether the park has public restrooms.

table:columns.name: Parking_Stalls
table:columns.description: Number of parking stalls at the park.

table:columns.name: BBQ_Pit
table:columns.description: Whether the park has a barbecue pit.

table:columns.name: Playground
table:columns.description: Whether the park has a playground.

table:columns.name: Jogging_Path_Miles
table:columns.description: Length of jogging path within the park, in miles.

table:columns.name: Baseball_Diamonds
table:columns.description: Number of baseball diamonds.

table:columns.name: Baseball_Lighting

table:columns.name: Basketball_Stands

table:columns.name: Basketball_Lighting
table:columns.description: Whether the basketball courts are lit.

table:columns.name: Soccer_Fields
table:columns.description: Number of soccer fields.

table:columns.name: Soccer_Lighting
table:columns.description: Whether the soccer fields are lit.

table:columns.name: Softball_Diamonds
table:columns.description: Number of softball diamonds.

table:columns.name: Softball_Lighting
table:columns.description: Whether the softball diamonds are lit.

table:columns.name: Tennis_Courts
table:columns.description: Number of tennis courts.

table:columns.name: Tennis_Lighting
table:columns.description: Whether the tennis courts are lit.

table:columns.name: Volleyball_Courts
table:columns.description: Number of volleyball courts.

table:columns.name: Volleyball_Lighting
table:columns.description: Whether the volleyball courts are lit.

table:columns.name: Electrical_Outlets
table:columns.description: Whether public electrical outlets are available.

table:columns.name: Water_Outlets
table:columns.description: Whether public water outlets are available.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text note entered by city staff. Unstructured and inconsistently populated.

table:columns.name: URL
table:columns.description: Link to a page about this feature on a city or partner website.

table:columns.name: ParkID
table:columns.description: Identifier of the park the feature belongs to, joining to the parks collection. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 41 rows, 41 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Park_ID
table:columns.description: Numeric identifier of the park the feature belongs to. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 41 rows, 41 distinct values, ranging 10 to 71.

table:columns.name: County
table:columns.description: County the feature falls in. Sandy is in Salt Lake County. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 41 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: State
table:columns.description: State the feature falls in. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 41 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: StreetNum
table:columns.description: House number component of the address. Measured in the published file: Populated on 98% of 41 rows, 38 distinct values.

table:columns.name: StreetName
table:columns.description: Street name component of the address. Measured in the published file: Populated on 98% of 41 rows, 33 distinct values.

table:columns.name: StreetType
table:columns.description: Street type component of the address, such as ST or AVE. Measured in the published file: Populated on 98% of 41 rows, 11 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Zip
table:columns.description: Postal ZIP code. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 41 rows, 4 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Reference
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source layer's domain allows: `Entrance`, `Center Point`, `Facility`, `Other`. Codes: `Entrance` = Entrance, `Center_Point` = Center Point, `Facility` = Facility, `Other` = Other.

table:columns.name: RefComment
table:columns.description: Note on what the reference point represents.

table:columns.name: Park_Acres
table:columns.description: Park area in acres as recorded by the department.

table:columns.name: AcreSource
table:columns.description: One of. The source layer's domain allows: `Parcel`, `Deed`, `Survey`, `GIS Value`, `Other`.

table:columns.name: YearOpen
table:columns.description: Year the feature opened to the public. Empty in all 41 rows of the published file.

table:columns.name: ParkStatus
table:columns.description: One of. The source layer's domain allows: `Open`, `Open_Fee`, `Open_Restricted`, `Closed`, `Decommissioned`, `Unknown`, `Planned`, `Proposed`.

table:columns.name: StatusCmnt
table:columns.description: Note on the park's status.

table:columns.name: ParkType
table:columns.description: Type of park, such as neighbourhood or regional.

table:columns.name: ServicArea
table:columns.description: One of. The source layer's domain allows: `0-0.5 miles`, `0-5 miles`, `0-25 miles`, `0-100 miles`, `0-100 or more miles`.

table:columns.name: MgtPriorty
table:columns.description: One of. The source layer's domain allows: `Active Park`, `Passive Park`, `Mixed-use Park`, `Natural Area`, `Historical/Cultural`, `Special Use Area`, `Corridor`.

table:columns.name: Landowner
table:columns.description: Organisation that owns the land. Values are organisations, not individuals.

table:columns.name: OwnerType
table:columns.description: One of. The source layer's domain allows: `Federal`, `State`, `County`, `Municipal`, `Special District`, `Private - NP`, `Private`, `Unknown`, `School`.

table:columns.name: AgencyName
table:columns.description: Organisation that manages the park, which is not always the owner.

table:columns.name: AgencyType
table:columns.description: One of. The source layer's domain allows: `Federal`, `State`, `County`, `Municipal`, `Special District`, `Private - NP`, `Private`, `Unknown`, `School`.

table:columns.name: AcqSource
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source layer's domain allows: `Donation`, `Transfer`, `Bond`, `Capital Budget`, `Special Tax or assessment`, `Exactions`, `Federal Grant`, `State Grant`, `Other Grant`, `Other`, and 2 more. Codes: `Donation` = Donation, `Transfer` = Transfer, `Bond` = Bond, `Capital Budget` = Capital Budget, `Special tax or assessment` = Special Tax or assessment, `Exactions` = Exactions, `Federal Grant` = Federal Grant, `State Grant` = State Grant, `Other Grant` = Other Grant, `Other` = Other, `Multiple` = Multiple, `Partnership` = Partnership.

table:columns.name: AcqMethod
table:columns.description: One of. The source layer's domain allows: `Fee simple`, `Easement`, `Lease`, `Eminent Domain`, `Land Exchange`, `Transfer`, `Donation`, `Other`.

table:columns.name: AcqComment
table:columns.description: Note on how the land was acquired.

table:columns.name: DevSource
table:columns.description: One of. The source layer's domain allows: `None`, `Donation`, `Bond`, `Capital Budget`, `Special tax or assessment`, `Exactions`, `Federal Grant`, `State Grant`, `Other Grant`, `Other`, and 2 more.

table:columns.name: DevComment
table:columns.description: Note on how the park was developed.

table:columns.name: Restricts
table:columns.description: One of. The source layer's domain allows: `None`, `Deed/Covenant`, `License`, `Easement`, `Lien`, `Zoning`, `Multiple`, `Other`.

table:columns.name: LWCFProt
table:columns.description: One of. The source layer's domain allows: `Yes`, `No`.

table:columns.name: OtherProt
table:columns.description: One of. The source layer's domain allows: `None`, `Federal Grant`, `State Specific`, `Conservation Easement`, `Trail Easement`, `Multiple`, `Railbank (Railtrail)`, `Unknown`.

table:columns.name: ResPrtCmnt
table:columns.description: Note on restrictions or protections that apply to the land.

table:columns.name: EditDate
table:columns.description: Timestamp when the row was last edited, from the geodatabase editor tracking. It records the database edit, not a change in the world.

table:columns.name: Unit
table:columns.description: Unit of the adjacent measurement column. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 41 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Unit_ID
table:columns.description: Identifier of the unit within the park.

table:columns.name: Unit_Acres
table:columns.description: Area in acres of this unit of the park, where a park is split into units.

table:columns.name: AddedTrails
table:columns.description: Trail mileage added within the park.

table:columns.name: Shape
table:columns.description: Residual Esri geometry field. It carries no coordinates here; the geometry is in the `geometry` column.

table:columns.name: Shape.area
table:columns.description: Polygon area computed by the geodatabase, in the square units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it, because it is not updated when a shape is edited.

table:columns.name: Shape.len
table:columns.description: Line length or polygon perimeter computed by the geodatabase, in the units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
